metadata.title: Player guide — Nebula
metadata.description: Find your controls, adjust the picture, add mods and keep your progress.

page.paragraph_2: Find your controls, adjust the picture, add mods and keep your progress.
page.paragraph_3: These instructions cover the upcoming update. The current public download is v1.0.2.

guides.paragraph_1: Ray tracing, resolution, upscaling and smoother motion.
guides.paragraph_2: Default buttons, gyro aiming, supported controllers and remapping.
guides.paragraph_4: Backups, Dolphin imports and save-file icons.
guides.paragraph_5: Common problems, error codes and reporting a bug.

questions.paragraph_1: Yes. Nebula is free software under the GNU GPL v3. You need your own copy of Super Mario Galaxy; game files are not included.
questions.paragraph_2: Not yet. v2 is coming soon. The current public release is v1.0.1. The v2 features described here are for the upcoming update.
questions.paragraph_3: No. In v2, Super Mario Galaxy runs as native code built from SMGCommunity’s Petari decompilation. The original levels, music, story and gameplay come from your own game.
questions.question_4: Which copy of the game do I need?
questions.paragraph_4: The supported copy is the North American Wii release, RMGE01, revision 0. For v2, prepare an ISO, RVZ or extracted folder. Support for other regions has not been announced.
questions.question_5: Can I play on Linux, Steam Deck, Android or Mac?
questions.paragraph_5: Windows is available now, and an Android beta is released. Linux and SteamOS are in development; macOS is planned.
questions.question_6: Can I use a Dolphin save?
questions.paragraph_6: Yes. Close the game, then use Advanced → Import saves in the launcher. See the save guide for the steps.
questions.paragraph_7: No. File replacements and compatible texture packs work, but mods that patch the Wii’s machine code may not run in a native game. Check the mod guide before importing.
questions.paragraph_8: No. Nebula is an independent project by the Nebula developers. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Nintendo.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
